proves.claim: an item naming a path no lane owns only in its criterion is claimed by claim <id> and by next.

cli.io-item-bar-claim-owners.read-only-p.why: Without it a bar citing a file the builder only reads refuses every claim, as on cells and contract projects.

proves.claim: an item whose Files list changes a path no lane owns gets CROSS_OWNERSHIP from claim <id>, and next passes over it with NOTHING_FREE.

cli.io-item-bar-claim-owners.claim-and-n.why: Without it next claimed what explicit claim refused; next now passes the item over instead, so it is never claimed by either route.

proves.claim: a seat whose uncommitted local config gives its lane the path gets the same CROSS_OWNERSHIP as a seat on main config.

cli.io-item-bar-claim-owners.main-config.why: Without it the answer depended on each seat folder's own config.
